Source: Dungeons and Dragon Ballz V.3, PDF page 129. Category: technique. Rank 4.

Rank 4 Melee technique
Ki Cost: 50 ki
Casting Time: 1 Bonus Action
Range: Melee/Melee weapon range
Chargeable?: No
Duration: Instantaneous
Make 8 combo attack rolls against a target of your
choice within range dealing your unarmed strike
damage die or your equipped melee weapon damage die
on a hit.
